entries: This gleaming mask is white with highlights of pale blue and is topped by a spined crest. The mask reshapes to fit a wearer attuned to it. While you are wearing the mask and attuned to it, you can access the following properties.

You have resistance against cold damage. If you already have resistance to cold damage from another source, you instead have immunity to cold damage. If you already have immunity to cold damage from another source, whenever you are subjected to cold damage, you take none of that damage and regain a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt of that type.
entries.name: Damage Absorption

entries: While you are wearing no armor, you can add your Charisma bonus to your Armor Class.
entries.name: Draconic Majesty

entries: If you have a breath weapon that requires rest to recharge, it gains a recharge of 6.
entries.name: Dragon Breath

entries: You gain {@sense darkvision} out to 60 feet, or to an additional 60 feet if you already have that sense. Once per day, you can gain {@sense blindsight} out to 30 feet for 5 minutes.
entries.name: Dragon Sight

entries: You can speak and understand Draconic. You also have advantage on any Charisma check you make against White Dragons.
entries.name: Dragon Tongue

entries: (1/Day) If you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead.
entries.name: Legendary Resistance

entries: While your current hit points are equal to or less than half your hit point maximum, you deal an extra {@damage 1d8} cold damage with your melee attacks.
entries.name: Winter's Fury

name: White Dragon Mask
